topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I tell ye, we've found the strangest thing this morn, a box all deep in the earth where no man remembers buryin' it. Ain't right, this is. Not a day goes by when I do nae think on the weight of the plow, the thirst of the soil, and the eyes of the saints watching over our toil. Now this? It sets me to wonderin’ about the hands that placed it there, the hearts that carried secrets heavy enough to bury under the earth. What if it holds somethin’ the soil itself wants to keep hid? We be farmers, bound to the turn of the seasons, and this box, it’s the whisper of the unknown. What folly to disturb what’s been laid to rest. I cannot shake the thought that this season may bear more than the harvest of wheat.
